column1: # Which frame of each app's App Preview the store shows before it is played.
# ASC calls it previewFrameTimeCode and defaults it to a few seconds in, which
# is where soccer's first upload put a picture of an EMPTY PITCH on the
# listing — the film spends its opening seconds building the board, so the
# early frames are the least worth showing. Pick the frame after the thing the
# film is about has happened, and write it here.
# Format: HH:MM:SS:FF. release_app.py's preview step applies it, and a frame
# can only be set while the version is NOT in review: Apple answers
# "Can't Commit Preview while Waiting For Review" with a 409.
